title: 生成式AI服务累计备案数
title_en: Cumulative filings of generative AI services
notes: registered 为“应用或功能完成登记”数（地方网信办登记、调用已备案模型的应用）。2025-12-01 的 663 款是备案数，出自中央网信办主任专访；当日登记数未公开（前后两个官方节点为 2025-11-01 登记 306 款、2025-12-31 登记 435 款），本站不插值。
notes_en: “registered” counts applications or features that have completed registration (registered with local cyberspace offices; applications that call already-filed models). The 663 services as of 2025-12-01 are filings, from an interview with the director of the Cyberspace Administration of China; the registration count for that date has not been published (the official counts either side are 306 on 2025-11-01 and 435 on 2025-12-31), and this site does not interpolate.
